tells.label: Face swap visible in mirror reflection
tells.detail: The man's face appears swapped onto the figure reflected in the mirror behind him, matching the claim of an AI-generated face swap.

evidence.quote: an AI-generated face swap of a Chinese comedian's skit

note.text: The video showing Erling Haaland getting spooked by his reflection is an AI-generated face swap of a Chinese comedian's skit, not real footage. https://leadstories.com/hoax-alert/2026/06/fact-check-altered-video-of-erling-haaland-eating-and-scaring-himself-is-a-face-swap-spoof-of-a-chinese-slapstick-comedy-video.html
